Target standard error a design implies, for the KL calibration

Source: R/npp_kl_calibration.R
npp_kl_expected_target_se.Rd

The standard error of the target estimate expected under the design, on the scale of the analysis. For a continuous, recurrent-event or time-to-event endpoint it is the design's sampling standard deviation over the root sample size per arm, which does not depend on the treatment effect. For a binary endpoint the standard error depends on the response rates, so taking it at the scenario's true rates would make the prior a function of the true treatment effect. It is taken instead at the design's control rate and the source treatment rate, i.e. at zero treatment drift, which is also the design the analysis step calibrates on (see compute_bayesian_ocs()).

Usage

npp_kl_expected_target_se(target_data, source)

Arguments

target_data

Target study data for the scenario.

source

The source data, with treatment_rate for a binary endpoint.

Value

The expected standard error.
